title_zh: 预约律师电话咨询上诉问题

scenario.label_zh: 预约上诉问题法律咨询
scenario.goal_zh: 说明咨询上诉的目的并确认与律师通话的预约时间

context_zh: 虚构服务对话中，安德烈致电律师事务所请求预约，不讨论应否上诉或法律结论。
author: author-phase06-c

sentences.speaker: Andre
sentences.text: I need to speak to an attorney about an appeal. Can I arrange a telephone appointment?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Hazel
sentences.text: Certainly. We have Tuesday at ten thirty or Wednesday at two.

sentences.speaker: Andre
sentences.text: Tuesday at ten thirty would work. What should I have with me?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Hazel
sentences.text: Have the decision letter ready so the attorney can understand what you are asking about. I cannot advise you on the appeal myself.

sentences.speaker: Andre
sentences.text: Understood. Please book Tuesday under Andre Bell.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Hazel
sentences.text: Your telephone appointment is booked for Tuesday at ten thirty. I will send the confirmation and the office contact details.

targets.sense_zh: 请求重新审理或改变裁定的上诉
